ABOUT KING LEEADE

King Leeade is a professional gospel guitarist and minstrel whose passion is to use music as a vessel for worship, encouragement and ministry. He specializes in lead and rhythm guitar, bringing expressive tone, musical sensitivity and excellence to every assignment.

From the stage to the studio, he serves with a heart for God and a commitment to quality sound. His musical workflow includes guitars, effects processors, FL Studio, Behringer UMC22 and his Epiphone Les Paul.

“Music is my ministry, and my guitar is my voice.”
